concepts.title: 青の男の子① 頁のショートケープ
concepts.desc: 軽快な主人公寄り。青い短いケープと頁形の裾。
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. ONE full-body character concept illustration, portrait 2:3. ONE original LORE character per image, head-to-boots visible, no other figures, no alternate face panels, no collages.
The user supplied FOUR character-reference screenshots. Use their ACTUAL DRAWING LANGUAGE: clean confident ink contours, selective line weights, designed angular hair clumps, large calm color shapes, crisp TWO-STEP CEL SHADOWS, flat local colors and tiny selective highlights. The result should look like a deliberately drawn official anime RPG character design illustration. Do not copy screenshot UI, text, borders, checkerboard, stars or logos.
CRITICAL QUALITY CORRECTION: previous concepts were too generic and AI-looking: too many little silver diamonds, same long white coats, crinkly shiny fabric, lifeless symmetrical poses, airbrushed doll faces. Replace that language with graphic 2D drawing, expressive youthful facial proportions, meaningful asymmetry and sparse memorable clothing shapes. NO rendered metallic creases everywhere, photorealistic fabric, glossy 3D rendering, smoky lighting, blurry gradients on the character, excessive filigree, jewel spam, belt spam or random dangling chains.
LORE outfit context: magical-library duelists who wield bound histories and illustrated cards. White/ivory architectural aesthetic, near-black navy foundation, silver eye/compass brand motif used ONCE as a simple clasp. Key items: one small bound chronicle OR one reading-lamp-like crystal, and a single bookmark ribbon. Fantasy tailoring, geometric page-like garment hems, clean fastenings. Neither modern office suit nor military armor. Keep enough unadorned cloth to see the DESIGN.
Young ADULT around 20, approachable anime protagonist age appearance, normal anatomy and expressive eyes, tasteful nonsexual clothing. Balanced interesting standing idle stance, shoulders and pelvis at slight opposing angles, clear negative space between arms and body. Face well visible, hands accurate. Clothing, hair and prop have coherent clean boundaries.
Composition for comparison: character occupies 86% of frame height, whole head and shoes within frame, very light warm-gray plain background, faint small grounding shadow only, no scene, no giant magic effects, no typography, no wordmark. Color belongs to the character. HIGH-QUALITY CLEAN DRAWN CHARACTER ART, not a shaded 3D render.
MALE REFERENCES: Combine attached reference 1 and reference 2 approximately equally in age, charm and shape design. From reference 1 take midnight/indigo blue layered spiky hair, a light blue face-framing lock, amber-gold eyes, cool high collar and a sharp blue-dark silhouette. From reference 2 take the warm youthful protagonist face, light agile build, compact adventurous clothes, elegant exposed forearm and a single short braided hair tail, ease of movement. Invent new clothing for LORE rather than reproducing either costume. Do NOT use the names or text in the references. Attached references 3 and 4 are NOT male design references.
Same underlying character across these proposals: youthful male, golden eyes, short tousled indigo-blue hair with one pale cyan lock across one side of forehead, a subtle short braid behind one ear, friendly composed expression. Character key color COBALT BLUE, visible in broad designed panels, balanced with ivory and near-black; restrained silver; no red dominant accent and no purple.
Variant A / agile page-reader. Compact cobalt short cape with ivory underside over ONE shoulder, fitted near-black high-neck sleeveless tunic with ivory central placket, the abdomen fully covered. Cobalt and ivory angular hip-length tabard panels shaped like two open pages, loose tapered navy trousers and simple ankle boots. Forearms mostly visible with short gloves. One broad silver eye clasp secures the cape; no other crest. A compact white closed chronicle rests outward in left hand, right hand holds one blue-backed card at waist. Slight relaxed weight on one leg, a small confident smile. The cape should be truly SHORT, not a floor-length coat. Warm approachable face and very clean graphic silhouette.
